api: OpenCAMLib ocl::BatchDropCutter (STLSurf+MillingCutter -> CLPoint collection) and ocl::Waterline; mature cutter-location generation.
FreeCAD Path/Op/Surface.py explicitly imports ocl/opencamlib; Base.py imports FreeCAD/Part/Path/PySide.
CAMotics README explicitly promises 3-axis NC simulation; no unsupported 5-axis/turn-mill claim.

license_assessment.root: OpenCAMLib LGPL-2.1-or-later checked source headers, LGPL2.1 COPYING; FreeCAD CAM Base/Surface LGPL-2.1-or-later; CAMotics GPL-2.0-or-later README + GPL2 COPYING.
license_assessment.boundary: OpenCAMLib library can be investigated under same LGPL source/relink discipline; all actual C++ source dependencies still need pinned review. FreeCAD Path root LGPL does not pre-clear all workbench/libarea/postprocessor dependencies. CAMotics GPL direct linking not cleared by current policy.

assessment.dependencies: OpenCAMLib C++14 + Boost headers, optional OpenMP(default on), Python/Node/Emscripten bindings disable/select; macOS libomp recipe not iOS proof. FreeCAD CAM needs Python/App/Part and OCL. CAMotics desktop SCons/Qt/OpenGL+other deps is not standalone iOS simulator SDK.

ios_evidence.device: OpenCAMLib no local iOS binary/runtime proof

assessment.integration_cost: Medium/high OCL headless shim; high professional CAM adapter; full multi-axis/turn-mill route unresolved.
assessment.remaining_floe_work: Tool/holder/stock/setup and work frames, feeds/speeds, operation history/rest machining, collisions/gouge verification, machining simulation and independent toolpath interchange. No machine-specific G-code needed per user scope; that exclusion does not create missing multi-axis or turning algorithms.
acceptance_pending: Fixed LGPL core closure, OpenMP off/native bounded CPU build for iOS device+sim, analytic toolpath accuracy fixtures and no-gouge/stock-removal simulation.
Separately identify mature licensed multi-axis + turn-mill toolpath/simulation backends; do not substitute custom engine or call 3-axis OCL/CAMotics professional E38 complete.
